Bihar BSSC Inter Level Recruitment 2025: Online Apply, Notification & Date - Complete Details

Bihar BSSC Inter Level Recruitment 2025: Online Apply, Notification & Date. Eligible candidates can apply online through the official website before the last date. The last date to apply is 25 नवंबर 2025. Check important dates, application fee, eligibility criteria and official links below.

Important Dates

  • Exam Name : Bihar BSSC Inter Level Exam 2025
  • Last Date to Apply : 25 नवंबर 2025
  • Exam Date : As Per Schedule
  • Other State Candidates : ₹540/-

Application Fee

  • Post Name : LDC, Revenue Employee, Panchayat Sachiv, etc.
  • Online Application Start : 15 अक्टूबर 2025
  • Last Date to Apply : 25 नवंबर 2025
  • General / OBC / EBC (Male) : ₹540/-
  • SC / ST (Bihar Domicile) : ₹135/-
  • Other State Candidates : ₹540/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
